content: PASETO v4.public uses Ed25519, message+header+footer+optional implicit assertion covered by PAE. Footer is authenticated but NOT encrypted -- readable by token holder, so no secrets in footer. Implicit assertions are not stored in token but affect signature -- must match exactly on both issue and verify or verification silently fails; mismatch is invisible to token holder. v4.local entire header+footer included in auth tag so any tampering including version/purpose prefix invalidates token. Clock skew tolerance defaults to 0 in most libs -- must be explicit.
